reviews.name: Peter jones
reviews.quote: i have followed Richard from his old clinic because i have found he is the best chiropractor in the region. He does everything very thoroughly and has excellent knowledge of spinal issues

reviews.name: Paul Mansell
reviews.quote: Went to the Back & Neck clinic back in April when I was in agony and incapacitated, having suffered on-and-off with my lower back for quite a few years.  Ongoing treatment has helped me hugely; it's been a lengthy process but well worth it, and worth the financial cost too.  Dr Richard is professional and friendly, ready with advice as well as expert treatment.  It's taken a lot of work from myself (daily exercises) as is to be expected, but seven months on and my back feels like it hasn't done in a very long time - I feel comfortable in my day-to-day life and even when handling heavy goods at work I feel fine.  Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Richard Corrado
reviews.quote: Had back trouble for a long time now. My job is physical and things had built up over time. Went to my doctor who was no help at all so went to see Dr Ridings. Very knowledgeable and seemed know what the problem was and how he could help. I started treatment and noticed an instant improvement. It has taken time to fully resolve the problem but after a few months have no back problems at all. Almost can't believe where I am now to where I was. I can't recommend highly enough. Dr Ridings is a true professional and a pleasure to work with. Thank you.

reviews.name: TGL Sports
reviews.quote: Purity was recommended to me by a relative. I have had lower back and hip pain for around 2yrs now due to bad posture as I sit in a car for long periods of time. After around 12 sessions I can definitely say that my pain is a lot less.. I'm taking a month off due to needing an operation but will be continuing as soon as I'm fit to do so. Thank you Dr Ridings for all your help.

reviews.name: Jane Willetts
reviews.quote: I had been suffering with neck, shoulder and head pain for quite some years and having taken so much medication I just got so desperate one day I thought enough is enough. That's when I went on line and found Richard at Purity Clinic dudley, I made the call and i haven't looked back since. I have reduced the medication and i feel so much like my old self. All I can advise is don't sit there suffering make the call NOW, as I wish I had years ago, Richard you are so knowledgeable, helpful and understanding and you put me at ease. A big thank you as I am virtually pain free x
